# Town of Marlboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Marlboro's three selectboard members as Molly Welch (Chair), Jeffrey Skramstad (Vice Chair), and Kate Kirkwood

Town of Marlboro, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town election (certified): Jeff Skramstad was re-elected to the Selectboard in 2026 with 314 votes; town sources print 'Jeff', and the recorded name is the directory's full form Jeffrey
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats Molly Welch (Chair, to 2028), Jeff Skramstad (to 2029), and Kate Kirkwood (to 2027)
Town of Marlboro, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town election (certified): Forrest Holzapfel was re-elected Town Clerk in 2026 with 360 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Forrest Holzapfel as Marlboro's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Forrest Holzapfel as Marlboro's town clerk
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats Rebecca Sevigny as Town Treasurer (elected, term to 2028; her three-year seat was filled in 2025 and was not on the 2026 ballot)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Rebecca Sevigny as Marlboro's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Rebecca Sevigny as Marlboro's town treasurer
Town of Marlboro, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town election (certified): Eric Matt was re-elected lister in 2026 with 371 votes
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats the three listers Eric Matt (to 2029), Evan Wyse (Chair, to 2027), and Forrest Holzapfel (to 2028)
Town of Marlboro, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town election (certified): S. Rose Watson was re-elected auditor in 2026 with 343 votes
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats the three auditors S. Rose Watson (to 2029), Gail MacArthur (to 2027), and Andy Reichsman (to 2028)
Town of Marlboro, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town election (certified): Sally M. White was re-elected Cemetery Commissioner in 2026 with 354 votes
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats the three cemetery commissioners Sally M. White (to 2029), Hollis Burbank-Hammarlund (to 2027), and Marcia L. Hamilton (to 2028)
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats Clarence Boston as Constable (elected, term to 2027)
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Officers' table seats Evan Wyse as Collector of Delinquent Taxes (elected, term to 2028)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Marlboro justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024
Town of Marlboro, 2025 Town Report: the report's justice of the peace block names the same five
